chartHelp.heading: Chart controls
chartHelp.spacingEven: Even: one slot per reading, so a sparse series stays readable — the time between readings isn't shown.
chartHelp.spacingDate: Date: each point sits at its real date across the period, so gaps in logging show as gaps.
chartHelp.average: Average draws a trailing average line over each chart; the raw readings fade to dashes behind it, and tapping a point shows the average there.
chartHelp.averageWindow: The average always covers calendar days — 1 week, 2 weeks or 1 month back from each point, whatever the spacing. Spacing only changes where the points sit.
chartHelp.averageCap: Only windows that fit the period are offered — no 1-month average on a week's view. Your choice comes back when it fits again.

body.deleteWeighInBody: This removes the body entry logged on {{date}}. This can't be undone.
body.logDialogDescription: BMI, FFMI, fat-free mass, and Navy BF% are derived from these inputs and your profile height + sex.
